softwareInnerHero.title: Security-Driven Networking
paragraphs: Fortinet is a global leader in broad, integrated, and automated cybersecurity solutions. Our Security Fabric platform delivers convergence of networking and security, enabling organizations to achieve better security outcomes while simplifying operations.
With over 500,000 customers worldwide, Fortinet provides comprehensive protection across the entire digital attack surface, from network to endpoint, cloud, and IoT environments.

Our solutions are powered by FortiOS, the industry's only operating system designed to converge networking and security, enabling organizations to achieve better security outcomes while simplifying operations.
